We have applied first two templates, got products (precursors). Need to continue applying remaining templates sequentially to each intermediate, building a tree with at least 6 reactions total. Likely each template applied to a molecule to break down further.

We have after template 20810: two precursors: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". Then template 2895 applied to first precursor gave "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". So we have three molecules now: the second from 20810 unchanged, and the product of 2895 (modified). Need to apply template 1914397 to something. Likely to the nitro aromatic? Let's try applying to the nitro-containing molecule.
